name: Gargoyle (Rite Publishing)
body:
Gargoyles are living creatures of sculpted stone and animate spirit, long associated with the architectural spires, cathedral roofs, and parapets of ancient cities. While standard bestiary gargoyles are vicious predators, player-character gargoyles represent free-willed, sentient guardians who have broken free of predatory instinct to walk the path of adventure.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits: Gargoyles possess stony resilience and predatory agility, but their fierce and monstrous visage can unsettle mortals. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, and -2 Charisma.
Type: Monstrous Humanoid (earth). Gargoyles are monstrous humanoids with the earth subtype.
Size: Medium. Gargoyles are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Gargoyles have a base land speed of 30 feet, and a fly speed of 30 feet (clumsy maneuverability).
Languages: Gargoyles begin play speaking Common and Terran. Bonus languages include Auran, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnome, and Undercommon.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Darkvision: Gargoyles can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
Stone Hide: A gargoyle’s rocky epidermis grants a +2 natural armor bonus to Armor Class.
Damage Reduction (Su): A gargoyle possesses DR 1/magic. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, this damage reduction increases by 1 (to a maximum of DR 5/magic at 20th level).
Offense Racial Traits
Natural Weapons: A gargoyle possesses two primary claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of slashing damage each (plus Strength modifier) and a primary bite attack that deals 1d4 points of piercing damage (plus Strength modifier).
Skill and Movement Racial Traits
Freeze (Ex): A gargoyle can hold itself so still it appears to be a carved stone statue. A gargoyle that stands motionless can take 20 on Stealth checks to conceal itself as a piece of stonework or architecture.
Stonework Climber: Gargoyles receive a +2 racial bonus on Climb checks made on stone surfaces and masonry.
